flashcards.q: Who is involved with objectives deliverables in Project Management?

flashcards.q: How is budgeted cost used in Project Management?
flashcards.a: Method: Earned Value Management (EVM) Key Metrics: - Planned Value (PV): Budgeted cost for scheduled work. - Actual Cost (AC): Real cost incurred. - Earned Value (EV): Budgeted cost for work performed.

flashcards.q: What does Project Management teach about budget?

flashcards.q: What should be avoided with earned Value in Project Management?
